use default

let factor_limit = 10_000
let composite = LIST(factor_limit)

(0..factor_limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2..factor_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= factor_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple < factor_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

let small_primes =
    (2..factor_limit) |> filter(value => !composite[value]) |> collect()

let segment_size = 1_000_000

prime_divisor_sums(with_multiplicity: bool)
    -> Pipe[(number: int, sum: int)]
is
    let low mut = 2

    do
        let high = low + segment_size
        let remaining = LIST(segment_size)
        let sums = LIST(segment_size)

        for offset in 0..segment_size do
            remaining.add(low + offset)
            sums.add(0)
        od

        for prime in small_primes do
            if prime * prime >= high then break fi

            let shortfall = low % prime
            let first =
                if shortfall == 0 then low else low + prime - shortfall fi

            let multiple mut = first

            while multiple < high do
                let offset = multiple - low

                if remaining[offset] % prime == 0 then
                    sums[offset] = sums[offset] + prime
                    remaining[offset] = remaining[offset] / prime

                    while remaining[offset] % prime == 0 do
                        if with_multiplicity then
                            sums[offset] = sums[offset] + prime
                        fi

                        remaining[offset] = remaining[offset] / prime
                    od
                fi

                multiple = multiple + prime
            od
        od

        for offset in 0..segment_size do
            let leftover = remaining[offset]
            let extra = if leftover > 1 then leftover else 0 fi

            yield (number = low + offset, sum = sums[offset] + extra)
        od

        low = high
    od
si

runs(with_multiplicity: bool, size: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let recent = LIST[int]()

    for entry in prime_divisor_sums(with_multiplicity) do
        recent.add(entry.sum)

        if recent.count > size then recent.remove_at(0) fi

        let alike mut = recent.count == size

        for index in 1..recent.count do
            if recent[index] != recent[0] then alike = false fi
        od

        if alike then yield entry.number - size + 1 fi
    od
si

let kinds = [(name = "factors", with_multiplicity = true),
             (name = "divisors", with_multiplicity = false)]

kinds |> each(kind => (
    let pairs = runs(kind.with_multiplicity, 2) |> take(30)

    write_line("first 30 Ruth-Aaron numbers ({kind.name}):")
    write_line("  {pairs |> join(" ")}")
))

write_line()

kinds |> each(kind => (
    let triple = runs(kind.with_multiplicity, 3) |> first_or_throw()

    write_line("first Ruth-Aaron triple ({kind.name}): {triple}")
))
